description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for the 'Matricula' entity, providing methods to query enrollment records based on course and user.

classes.name: MatriculaRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for handling persistence of Matricula entities.

methods.name: findAllByCurso
methods.description: Returns a list of Matricula entities associated with a specific Curso.

methods.name: findAllByUsuario
methods.description: Returns a list of Matricula entities associated with a specific User.

methods.name: findByCursoAndUsuario
methods.description: Finds a Matricula entry matching both a specific Curso and User.
